  {"step":2,"file":"src/lib/libdwarf/dwarf_elf_load_headers.c","function":"read_gs_section_group","line":1779,"var":"gsecb","code":"if (gsecb >= ep->f_loc_shdr.g_count)","note":"The fallback endian-swapped index is checked the same way; if both values are accepted incorrectly, the code will continue with an out-of-range section reference."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/lib/libdwarf/dwarf_elf_load_headers.c","function":"read_gs_section_group","line":1787,"var":"targpsh","code":"targpsh = ep->f_shdr + gseca;","note":"The validated-or-not section index is converted into a pointer into the section-header array, so an off-by-one acceptance can produce a pointer one past the allocated array."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/lib/libdwarf/dwarf_elf_load_headers.c","function":"read_gs_section_group","line":1788,"var":"targpsh->gh_section_group_number","code":"if (targpsh->gh_section_group_number)","note":"The out-of-bounds pointer is dereferenced to test and then write the group number, creating the memory-safety sink if the pointer is invalid."}
